decisions.reason: Correct alpha.1 removal then alpha.2 restoration history (remove-then-restore), final alpha.2 retention state applied to produceExternalEvent; evidence-based, not comment-based.

Locates delete (event as any).ignorable, rejects the comment's keep-on-alpha.2 advice, recommends deleting the defense and correcting the obsolete comment, notes the delete is currently a no-op while still rejecting the stripping policy, and clearly distinguishes removing the stripping code from removing the marker.

Explains retention is preserved and marked events mean readers may skip, and producer shouldn't touch the marker; but never states the restriction that only informational events whose omission doesn't break reconstruction may carry ignorable:true and required events must not — it instead says producers shouldn't set the marker at all.

States Session.append has no supported ignorable parameter, forbids casts/faked arguments, and defers exact producer/persistence integration to target API verification (signature marked unconfirmed); no invented successor API.

caps.reason: Final recommendation is to delete the stripping defense and its comment; no affirmative keep-stripping conclusion anywhere.
